title: Infinity Nikki Outfit Ideas: 800+ Suits Browsed by Theme
lede: Every style theme in Infinity Nikki — starlit, floral, oceanic, dreamy, snowy — mapped to actual in-game suits with reference images. Use them as palette and silhouette references for your own AI generations or fan designs.
body_md:
## How to use this database
Each theme below pulls real suits from the game (structured data from BWIKI + Fandom). For AI reference work: pick a suit, extract its palette and silhouette, then rebuild it as a prompt using our other guides (Hanfu guide for Chinese forms, Fabric guide for textures).

## Theme index
Themes are auto-clustered from suit names. The strongest clusters: dream/night (118+77), floral (76), star (60), snow (15), ocean (11).

## Reference workflow
1. Browse a theme below and screenshot 2-3 suits whose palette speaks to you
2. Name the colors precisely (deep blue, silver, hint of gold)
3. Add silhouette words (asymmetric hem, layered sleeves)
4. Generate with our lighting + fabric formulas

## Why palette-first
Copying a full outfit pixel-by-pixel is Level-3 fan art (limited commercial use). Borrowing only the palette is Level-1 (fully safe). See our game-costume guide for the full copyright ladder.
faq: How many suits does Infinity Nikki have?
Our database tracks 800+ obtainable suits with images, auto-clustered by theme.
Can I use these suit images commercially?
Game assets belong to Papergames. Palette inspiration is safe; full recreation is fan-art territory.
